[EN] You've done well, ...but Velik's Sanctuary is still not completely safe, so long as Lakan's dark power lingers.

We have much to discuss. I'll return Oriyn's Arcana to Highwatch, but then let's meet up at in Velika, at headquarters.
[ES] Lo has hecho bien, ... pero Velik's Sanctuary aún no está completamente a salvo, mientras el poder oscuro de Lakan siga presente.

Tenemos mucho de qué hablar. Devolveré Oriyn's Arcana a Highwatch, pero luego reunámonos en Velika, en el cuartel general.
